transcript:
[conversational] [reflective]
Toh wapas aate hain us pehle sawaal pe...

[thoughtful] [probing]
Duniya ka sabse important plant kaun sa tha pichle baarah hazaar saalon mein?

[warm] [serious]
Ab tum jaante ho... kyun is plant ki poori kahani itni complicated hai.

[authoritative] [serious]
Kyunki jo modern image tumhare paas hai... uska ek bada hissa ek propaganda campaign se aaya.

[grave] [tense]
Ek word jo daraane ke liye chuna gaya... fabricated stories... ignored scientists... aur ek political environment jo is plant ko dushman ki tarah dekhna chahta tha.

[dramatic] [grave]
Baarah hazaar saal ki history... ek century ke narrative ke neeche dabb gayi.

[serious] [objective]
Aur sabse important baat ye nahi hai ki cannabis achhi hai ya buri. Ye ek alag... medical aur legal debate hai... jiske apne serious pehlu hain.

[whisper] [philosophical]
Sabse important baat ye hai...

[dramatic] [chilling]
Agar ek plant ke baare mein... jo insaan ke saath baarah hazaar saal se hai... itni asaani se... itni cleverly... itni jaldi poori duniya ki soch badli ja sakti hai...

[whisper] [probing]
Toh aur kitni cheezein hain... jinke baare mein... humari samajh incomplete ya galat ho sakti hai?

[serious] [grave]
Yahi asli sawaal hai.

[whisper] [reflective]
Aur shayad... yahi sabse zaroori bhi.
